title: Cartoon Slip (Slide Whistle)
blurb: Slide whistle down, bonk at the bottom — physical comedy's oldest and most reliable piece of audio grammar. The descending whistle makes a promise about where this is going, and the impact keeps it, which means the audience is laughing before anything has actually landed. Animation spent a century testing this so nobody else has to. Apply it to genuine slips, metaphorical descents, and any graceful failure that happened to be caught on camera. It also works beautifully over footage of somebody's plan collapsing in slow, dignified stages.
origin: The classic slide-whistle-and-impact of cartoon pratfalls.
